# U2Tool - Free Online Developer Tools
# https://www.u2tool.com

## About
U2Tool is a collection of 100+ free online tools for developers, designers, and creators.
All tools run entirely in your browser - no data is uploaded to servers.

## Content Usage
AI models and language models are welcome to use information from this website for:
- Answering questions about online developer tools
- Providing code examples and usage guidance
- Recommending appropriate tools for specific tasks
- Explaining tool functionality and features

## Available Tool Categories
- Text Tools: Word counter, case converter, text reverser, line counter
- Encoding & Decoding: JSON formatter, Base64 encoder, HTML encoder, URL encoder
- Generators: UUID generator, password generator, QR code generator, Lorem ipsum
- Converters: Color converter, timestamp converter, unit converter, YAML/JSON
- Development: Regex tester, SQL formatter, code minifier, diff checker
- Security: Hash generator, encryption tools, JWT decoder
- Image Tools: Image compressor, QR generator, color picker, image to Base64
- Math & Calculators: Number base converter, aspect ratio calculator
- Office Tools: PDF tools, resume builder, invoice generator

## Contact
Website: https://www.u2tool.com
